ops.title: long-running: decouple unconditional Sprite job repack while preserving startup freshness
ops.description:
Each qualifying Sprite job runs remote git fetch --all then explicit geometric repack under the checkout lock. The existing began-after-asked contract is intentional and must remain unchanged. Owner /root next: choose frozen option A (fetch-only startup with separately owned maintenance) or B (explicit repack only for demonstrated pack-set change), then assign bounded implementation. Local fetch77546 was git fetch origin under d50 and is not joined to this remote bootstrap.
Evidence: /Users/yasyf/.local/state/host-pressure-recovery/runs/20261026T235128-repeat/fundamental-efficiency/long-running-remote-default-and-fetch-source-diagnosis.json SHA256 86e40e195bf63e9b2b979c0a5f8d70231ffba26b70709db8d46fce32df4953e6.

ops.text: CI preserves concurrent and sequential asked/began refresh ordering and ref/credential/empty-ref behavior; no completion-marker or TTL substitution.
CI proves explicit repack invocation counts under the selected option for unchanged and changed packs without scanning the object corpus.
Merge, release, install and verify on naturally owned remote jobs with separate bootstrap/fetch/repack timings; do not attribute their remote bytes to Mac physical I/O without evidence.
